purpose: Test causal additional AND gates; never rewrite any existing opportunity or its levels/costs.
price_input_contract: Closed 1m bars use open labels; closed 3/5/15m prepared bars use right labels. Caller verifies the real as-of clock for the 1m inputs.
universal_active_gate_guard: Valid latest closed 1m OHLCV with positive volume. Required aggregate samples must be current, contiguous, same-session and positive-volume. Missing/nonfinite values are unavailable and fail active gates, never zero-filled.

gate_definitions.ema15_up: Four contiguous same-session closed 15m candles: EMA20[-1]>EMA20[-4] AND close[-1]>EMA20[-1].
gate_definitions.bullish3_close65: Latest closed 3m candle: close>open AND (close-low)/(high-low)>=0.65. Flat range is unavailable.
gate_definitions.reversal3: Existing confirmed_reversal on two contiguous completed positive-volume 3m candles: higher low AND close above preceding high.
gate_definitions.vwap3_up: Three contiguous same-session closed 3m VWAP values strictly increase AND current observed price>latest VWAP.
gate_definitions.volume3_ge125: Latest closed 3m volume_ratio>=1.25, not a remembered earlier surge.
gate_definitions.noise_ge050atr: Existing (entry-soft_stop)/ATR3>=0.5. Reject a too-tight existing setup; do not move any stop.
gate_definitions.target1_le4atr: Existing (target1-entry)/ATR3<=4. Reject a too-distant target; do not move any target.
gate_definitions.target1_le6atr: Existing (target1-entry)/ATR3<=6. Separate preregistered hypothesis, not an outcome-driven adjustment to S07.
gate_definitions.micro_reversal1: Three contiguous same-session positive-volume closed 1m candles: low1<low2<low3 AND close3>high1.

strategy_expansion_amendment.purpose: Compare the unchanged established-nine control against four independently classified causal expansion strategies before observing replay outcomes.

strategy_expansion_amendment_v2.purpose: Extend the unchanged established-nine control comparison with six more independently classified causal structures before the second replay outcomes are observed.

invariants: Only a common-engine replay counts as performance evidence
report_requirements: Per-market and per-strategy entries/T1 hits/rate/duration, daily distinct symbols and daily goal; include zeros, exclusions and failures. Do not claim 80% proven from this plan or mocks.
amendments: Change assumptions only under a newly registered id; retain this file and original trial results. No holdout execution without explicit user approval.
